First Appeared: @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.SUWNsmWvbkJyVUMV]{Session 6}
Status: Active
Affiliation: @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.WXUNMFUew0ikdeY3]{Aldric Garlandsson}, @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.VxJKyJDX5JtaCOX7]{Crownvale}

Description

The older head of @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.WXUNMFUew0ikdeY3]{Aldric}'s guard, marked by a golden brooch shaped like a crown upon a mountain — the symbol of @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.VxJKyJDX5JtaCOX7]{Crownvale}.
A true believer in Aldric, he sincerely sings his lord's praises and speaks for his growing authority over the Vale.

Role

He led the party sent to the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Yaz5mCHyP6xdTwoc]{Witch Stones} to retrieve @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.2H09dC5u3Cx4I9uf]{Mira} and to pressure @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.crg1JpVHgdUHPdOO]{Castor} over the beaver troubles, escorting the heads of the Vale's three great families.
He revealed that Aldric somehow knows everything that happens in the Vale — even that the beaver could speak.
He frames Aldric's consolidation as building the Vale into a "proud land" able to stand against the aggressions of Marrow and Beaconhold, and promises that once that power is complete "all will be revealed."

Methods

He commands through loyalty and conviction rather than cruelty, genuinely persuaded of Aldric's greatness.
At the Witch Stones he tried to hold @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.eNop3Y7Qd04NHq5f]{Garland} back from the portal, but was overruled when his own sergeant defied him.

Relationships

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.WXUNMFUew0ikdeY3]{Aldric Garlandsson} — His lord, whom he reveres
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.racfNNSIG5McsifR]{Sergeant Iyer} — His subordinate, who defied him at the Witch Stones
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.eNop3Y7Qd04NHq5f]{Garland yn Greenholt} — Confronted at the Witch Stones

Key Events

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.SUWNsmWvbkJyVUMV]{Session 6} — Led the delegation to the Witch Stones; revealed Aldric's uncanny knowledge of the Vale; tried and failed to stop Garland from following Mira through the portal

Session Appearances

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.SUWNsmWvbkJyVUMV]{Session 6}
